desc: stash mission end-to-end — the sustain-loop 'unload' leg. The bot starts a few blocks from a storage chest, carrying raw iron + iron ingots (to deposit) plus a diamond pickaxe (to KEEP, not on the whitelist). It greedy-walks to the chest, opens it (useOnBlock — the step fetch is missing), shift-clicks the whitelisted ids in, and closes. PASS = STASH_DEPOSITED then STASH_DONE, no ERROR; the pickaxe must remain in the bag (whitelist filtering). Chest at (5,101,0); bot starts at (0,101,0).
